claims: A-Train (Reggie Franklin) dies in the season 5 premiere of The Boys.
Homelander kills A-Train by snapping his neck in the final moments of the season 5 premiere episode of The Boys.
Nerdist notes that A-Train was cornered by Homelander after a heroic act and killed.
Jessie T. Usher told TVLine he felt his character’s death was "a long time coming," as he had few allies left.
Eric Kripke is the showrunner of The Boys.
Eric Kripke told TheWrap that A-Train's death was intended to bring the character's arc full circle, mirroring the reckless speedster seen in the pilot of The Boys.
Season 5 of The Boys is now streaming on Prime Video.
